package.name: nitros_zc_bench
package.description: Consumer-side benchmark for the realsense2_camera NITROS zero-copy color path: compares a plain sensor_msgs/Image consumer (which must copy every frame host-to-device) against a NITROS consumer that reads the frame in place on the GPU. Both run the identical CUDA kernel over every pixel, so the only difference measured is how the frame reaches the GPU.
